mapper.select: SELECT p.user_id, u.nick_name, u.avatar, COALESCE(p.proofing_point, 0) as proofing_point, COALESCE(p.proofing_level, 0) as priifing_level, CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.proofing_level, 0) >= 200 THEN '5级-信誉大师' WHEN COALESCE(p.proofing_level, 0) >= 150 THEN '4级-信誉专家' WHEN COALESCE(p.proofing_level, 0) >= 100 THEN '3级-信誉达人' WHEN COALESCE(p.proofing_level, 0) >= 50 THEN '2级-信誉新手' ELSE '1级-信誉入门' END as priifing_level_name, COALESCE(p.sale_point, '0') as sale_point, COALESCE(p.sale_level, '1级-信誉入门') as sale_level, CASE WHEN CAST(COALESCE(p.sale_point, '0') AS UNSIGNED) >= 200 THEN '5级-信誉大师' WHEN CAST(COALESCE(p.sale_point, '0') AS UNSIGNED) >= 150 THEN '4级-信誉专家' WHEN CAST(COALESCE(p.sale_point, '0') AS UNSIGNED) >= 100 THEN '3级-信誉达人' WHEN CAST(COALESCE(p.sale_point, '0') AS UNSIGNED) >= 50 THEN '2级-信誉新手' ELSE '1级-信誉入门' END as sale_level_name, (COALESCE(p.proofing_point, 0) + CAST(COALESCE(p.sale_point, '0') AS UNSIGNED)) as total_point, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(p.proofing_point, 0) + CAST(COALESCE(p.sale_point, '0') AS UNSIGNED)) >= 200 THEN '5级-信誉大师' WHEN (COALESCE(p.proofing_point, 0) + CAST(COALESCE(p.sale_point, '0') AS UNSIGNED)) >= 150 THEN '4级-信誉专家' WHEN (COALESCE(p.proofing_point, 0) + CAST(COALESCE(p.sale_point, '0') AS UNSIGNED)) >= 100 THEN '3级-信誉达人' WHEN (COALESCE(p.proofing_point, 0) + CAST(COALESCE(p.sale_point, '0') AS UNSIGNED)) >= 50 THEN '2级-信誉新手' ELSE '1级-信誉入门' END as comprehensive_level, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM sd_user_normal_point p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sd_user_normal_point SET proofing_point = COALESCE(proofing_point, 0) + #{pointChange}, proofing_level = CASE WHEN COALESCE(proofing_point, 0) + #{pointChange} >= 200 THEN 200 WHEN COALESCE(proofing_point, 0) + #{pointChange} >= 150 THEN 150 WHEN COALESCE(proofing_point, 0) + #{pointChange} >= 100 THEN 100 WHEN COALESCE(proofing_point, 0) + #{pointChange} >= 50 THEN 50 ELSE COALESCE(proofing_point, 0) + #{pointChange} END, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE sd_user_normal_point SET sale_point = CAST(COALESCE(sale_point, '0') AS UNSIGNED) + #{pointChange}, sale_level = CASE WHEN CAST(COALESCE(sale_point, '0') AS UNSIGNED) + #{pointChange} >= 200 THEN '5级-信誉大师' WHEN CAST(COALESCE(sale_point, '0') AS UNSIGNED) + #{pointChange} >= 150 THEN '4级-信誉专家' WHEN CAST(COALESCE(sale_point, '0') AS UNSIGNED) + #{pointChange} >= 100 THEN '3级-信誉达人' WHEN CAST(COALESCE(sale_point, '0') AS UNSIGNED) + #{pointChange} >= 50 THEN '2级-信誉新手' ELSE '1级-信誉入门' END, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
